mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following 2-month INDPRO sub-50 readings.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following a 0.5pp 3-month rise in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines for two consecutive months, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following 2-month YoY declines in both HOUST and RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and rising, and the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is below 50, it signals a toxic combination of weak labor market and industrial activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and rising, and INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 60 for three consecutive months, it signals a period of strong industrial activity and supply chain health that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of instances following 3-month INDPRO readings above 60.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 3%, it signals a dangerous mix of ultra-loose monetary policy and rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 3%.
